title: Collector exporter sending queues
description: otelcol_exporter_queue_size against queue_capacity per pod, exporter and data type (traces, metrics, logs; null on a version that does not label the queue by data type). utilizationPercent is size over capacity (null when either is not reported); atOrAboveThreshold compares it with the queueUtilizationPercent setting (thresholdPercent); full is size at or above capacity: new data is refused or dropped by that exporter. Worst first. An exporter without a sending queue (for example debug) has no entry. noQueuedExporters is true when no pod reported any exporter queue (count 0): the collector has no exporter with a sending queue, or this version does not export the queue gauges; it is a fact, not a failure.
